prompt: Create an 8-pose right-facing combat walk sprite atlas for Mogami Yoshiaki using the references. Preserve his exact green and dark armor, silver flower crests, helmet, face, quiver and tall Japanese bow. Reference 1 defines character design; reference 2 defines existing game sprite style and scale. Arrange exactly 8 full-body poses in a clean 4-column by 2-row grid on perfectly flat pure #FF00FF magenta. No visible grid, borders, text, labels, effects, shadows, scenery, arrows in flight, or attack action. Keep his bow in a steady ready carry. Make a real grounded walk cycle: frame 1 right-foot-forward contact, 2 weight transfer, 3 left foot passes, 4 left foot swings forward, 5 opposite contact with left foot forward/right foot back, 6 weight transfer, 7 right foot passes, 8 right foot swings into frame 1. Ensure clear support-leg exchange at frames 1 and 5 and distinct passing/stride poses. Stable torso and bow. Identical anatomy and scale in every panel; complete antlers, clothing, bow, quiver and body comfortably inside each invisible cell, no cross-cell overlaps.
